PREMIERE316 STYLE-ONLY IMAGE REFERENCE CONTROL — V2
Asset ID: artifact-moses-staff-symbol-of-divine-authority-close-up
Workflow profile: 2X3_VERTICAL (2:3)
Reference mode: ART DIRECTION ONLY — NO SUBJECT OR DESIGN TRANSFER.

The loaded images are non-content style plates. The asset prompt below is the sole authority for subject, identity, age, ethnicity, anatomy, wardrobe design, prop design, environment geometry, creatures, crowd population, pose, action, camera composition, wounds, blood placement, text, and all story content.

ALLOWED TRANSFER ONLY: overall palette; contrast curve; key/fill/rim relationship; volumetric-light behavior; atmosphere density; material highlight and shadow response; lens/exposure language; practical texture fidelity; cinematic depth; restrained film grain.

FORBIDDEN TRANSFER: faces or facial geometry; body identity or proportions; hairstyles; costume silhouettes; wounds or blood maps; weapons or props; architecture or set geography; creature designs; crowd layout; pose; framing; four-panel layout; lettering; logos; or any recognizable object from a reference, unless the asset prompt itself explicitly requests that exact element.

Prop/artifact guard: transfer only material response, patina, highlight rolloff, and photographic presentation. Do not add a glowing sword, sacred symbols, blood, or human hands unless this row explicitly requires them.

Active plate roles: warm-gold lighting and highlight rolloff; smoky umber shadow palette and ember atmosphere; abstract filmic tonal/material response and restrained grain.
When a reference conflicts with the row prompt, ignore the reference and obey the row prompt.

AUTHORITATIVE ASSET PROMPT
--------------------------
MOSES' STAFF - SYMBOL OF DIVINE AUTHORITY — CLOSE-UP: HERO PROP DESIGN, CONSTRUCTION, MATERIALS, SCALE, AND CONTINUITY.

Photorealistic live-action production reference, physically coherent lighting, exact anatomy, clean hands, consistent scale and materials, no captions, no logos, no watermarks, no borders, and no written or graphical elements.

Hero prop close-up of Moses' ancient wooden staff—symbol of divine authority and deliverance—held at the moment of liberation in Hell's Inner Chamber after the chains break. A single piece of dense desert hardwood, roughly six feet overall, framed as a tight cinematic prop study with the complete object readable: natural living curve of a shepherd's staff, slight taper from thicker grip to slimmer tip, never machine-straight. Wood is deep walnut-brown with cooler ash-grey weathering where bark once clung; tight annual rings and long-grain structure fully visible under raking light. Surface history is millennia of use made physical: hand-polished sheen at the grip from Moses' palm oil and sweat, micro-abrasion and fine longitudinal checks from dry desert air, small stone nicks along the lower shaft, darkened soot film and fine ash dust from Hell's captivity caught in the grain, and faint pale dust of broken chain corrosion clinging in shallow pores. Near the grip, subtle divine burnishing—not carved lettering, not readable symbols, not hieroglyphs—reads as warmer honey-gold subsurface glow along compressed fibers where sacred power once coursed, as if the wood itself remembers the parting of waters; soft raised ridge wear where fingers habitually closed. No metal ferrule, no modern hardware, no factory leather—only optional thin ancient rawhide binding, darkened and frayed. An elderly freed prophet's lean hand may enter only as grip scale: Mediterranean weathered skin, age spots, prominent tendons and knuckles, fine white hair on the wrist, clean anatomy, no jewelry, short earth-stained nails, firm dignified hold. Background is shallow Inner Chamber atmosphere after liberation begins—soft bokeh of black stone shifting toward pale marble, residual cool blue torch light at the extreme periphery surrendering to warm amber and ethereal gold divine radiance, fine ash and dust motes catching god-ray shafts. Lighting: warm amber key from camera-right front raking across grain, soft low cool-blue fill so shadows keep depth without muddying wood color, thin golden rim along the far edge, gentle speculars on the polished grip without plastic gloss. Camera: extreme close-up to medium-close prop study, 85–100mm equivalent feel, shallow DOF with tack-sharp focus on grip grain and divine burnish, staff set diagonally so both ends stay inside frame for full-object continuity, 2.39:1-friendly cinematic framing. Color grade: honey wood and warm amber against residual blue-black hell shadow with subtle gold divine accents. Continuity locks: same staff Moses carries when he emerges staff-in-hand among Abraham, David with broken harp, Elijah in skins, and John the Baptist; simple shepherd authority object, wood only, ancient and sacred—not a magician's wand or ornate temple relic. Reverent biblical-epic photoreal production still. No modern objects, logos, readable text, carved writing, watermarks, borders, UI, or captions.

Neutral production reference framing, the complete object visible, accurate materials and scale, no labels or text.
